title: Close Plant History and export secret redaction
verify: Independent security verification exercises actual Plant History and retained-history/export serialization with the configured corpus, observes no raw value, preserves safe refs and response shapes, and confirms failure output leaks nothing.
evidence_required: FT-015-AC-012 RED/GREEN: exercise actual Plant History and retained-history/export serialization with the configured corpus; RED is any raw value or unprovable unsafe serialization branch, GREEN is corpus absence or safe rejection before response/export with existing refs, paths, and cursor behavior preserved; decisive comparison: serialized card/history payloads, safe failure output, and unchanged source value; artifact: focused transcript under .tasks/TASK-071-T3-FT-015-W2/. Preserve exact pre-implementation GREEN when present.
purpose: Close the Plant-History-owned serialization result independently from Timeline append behavior.
success_outcome: Plant History and retained-history/export serialization remove or reject the forbidden corpus before output, retain registered safe refs and public response compatibility, and fail without echoing rejected data.
anti_goals: Do not change history response schemas, cursors, authorization/retention, PostgreSQL projection authority, or Timeline append behavior.
Do not adopt manifest, Bus/UI, provider-context, or browser-capture claims.
constraints: Apply the existing response-safe projection before serialization and preserve URL-first safe-ref behavior.
Keep PostgreSQL as projection authority and Timeline independent.
invariants: No Plant History or retained-history/export output contains the forbidden corpus.
History serialization cannot mutate PostgreSQL state or Timeline audit.
verification_targets: FT-015-AC-012: actual Plant History/export RED/GREEN or preserved pre-GREEN, corpus absence, safe failure, source-value integrity, and response/cursor compatibility.

forbidden_scope: Timeline writer or registry, history schema/cursor redesign, mutable state repair, manifest, Bus/UI, agent runtime, frontend, or sync.
stop_conditions: Redaction requires changing a public history response or accepted URL/path policy.
The Plant History owner cannot fail safely without a new shared/global decision.
